Guideline: Use useOptimistic for 0ms Game-Feel State Commits
Description: React 19 useOptimistic lets toggles, likes, and task checks update in 0ms while the async action settles, rolling back automatically on error.
Do: Pair useOptimistic with a rollback trauma-shake class on error
Don't: Wait for await fetch() before flipping a checkbox or like state
Code Good: const [optLiked, addOpt] = useOptimistic(liked, (_, next: boolean) => next);
Code Bad: const onClick = async () => { setLoading(true); await api(); setLiked(true); };

Description: Browsers block AudioContext creation before a user gesture. Store a single AudioContext in a module/ref and initialize on first pointerdown.
Do: Reuse one AudioContext across all micro-interactions
Don't: Call new AudioContext() on every click (hits browser hardware context limit of 6 and throws)
Code Good: const ctx = audioRef.current ??= new window.AudioContext(); if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
Code Bad: onClick={() => { const ctx = new AudioContext(); /* leaks context! */ }}

Guideline: Clean Up Hover Grace Timers in useEffect
Description: When implementing a 150ms Coyote Time delay on dropdowns or hover cards, store the timer in useRef and clear it on unmount.
Do: Clear closeTimerRef.current on pointerenter and unmount
Don't: Use raw setTimeout without ref tracking or close immediately on onMouseLeave

Guideline: Mutate CSS Variables via ref for Cursor Tracking
Description: For radial spotlights, magnetic buttons, and 3D card tilt, update style.setProperty('--x', ...) via ref instead of React useState.
Do: Update DOM style properties or CSS variables directly in onPointerMove
Don't: Call setMousePos({x, y}) on every pointermove (causes 60-120 React re-renders per second)
Code Bad: const [pos, setPos] = useState({x:0,y:0}); onPointerMove={(e) => setPos({x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY})}

Guideline: Re-trigger CSS Trauma Shake via Key or Web Animations API
Description: If a user submits an invalid form twice in a row, a static CSS class won't replay the @keyframes shake unless re-triggered via element.animate().
Do: Use ref.current?.animate(shakeKeyframes, { duration: 300 }) on validation error
Don't: Toggle a boolean state that stays true on consecutive errors (second error won't shake)
